question: Will a registered technical event of a sensor channel start within the horizon after the daily cutoff?
interpretation: registered technical event (sustained connection loss or technical value); not a confirmed breakdown; the cause is known only after a field visit

connection_loss_1h.label: connection_loss
connection_loss_1h.episode_filter: duration >= 1 h or still open at data end
connection_loss_1h.decision: user 2026-09-26: sustained loss of connection that justifies a crew visit

technical_value.label: technical_value
technical_value.scope_note: temperature is the effective case; gas and UPS reported, not tuned

units.prediction: channel x cutoff; channels in an active episode or inside the Q shadow at t are not candidates
units.card: object_id x sensor_type at cutoff; card score = max of candidate channel scores; card lists channels with pickets
units.event: mass cluster: episode starts of one object within 10 min chained; an event qualifies if at least one member episode passes the target filter
units.card_positive: at least one qualifying event starts on a candidate channel of the card in [t, t+H)
units.event_captured: a card at cutoff t covers at least one channel of the event and the event starts in [t, t+H); lead = event start - t

periods.holdout_note: not evaluated for any sensor-failure label before this freeze; the same months were viewed for other targets (alarm studies), so the holdout is not blind in the strict sense
periods.excluded: 2021 and cutoffs whose 30-day lookback touches 2021 or starts before 2019-01-01

F1.meaning: own channel failure history, message/alarm activity, calendar, sensor/system type

F2.meaning: + context: failures and clusters of the same object / object x sensor type / system in the past

F3.meaning: + own value_numeric dynamics (temperature/gas: level, z, trend, stuck value)

feature_sets.scope: the F1/F2/F3 ablation is fitted for the main 24h horizon; declared 48h and 168h horizons use F3 only; declared label sensitivities are scored with the main-target F3 models

fit_rows.rule: development candidate rows with a known label: all positives plus negatives with sha256('sensor-failure-model-v1:' + channel_id + ':' + issued_at) mod 100 < 10
fit_rows.weighting: negatives weighted by 10 before class balancing so the sampled set represents development
fit_rows.scoring: every calibration and holdout candidate row is scored, in monthly chunks
fit_rows.added: 2026-09-26 before any fit, because development has about 20 million channel-days

baselines.persistence: rank channels by hours since the last candidate of the label (ascending, none = last), ties by episode starts in the past 30 days
baselines.type_rate: development start rate of the channel's sensor type

logreg.transform: sign(x)*log1p(|x|) then RobustScaler, all fitted on development

calibration.method: isotonic regression of the card score on calibration_and_threshold cards; channel scores stay rankings
calibration.display_rule: the word 'вероятность' is used only if holdout card-level ECE <= 0.05; otherwise 'оценка риска'

evaluation.primary: holdout, horizon 24h, 10 cards/day: event recall and card precision versus persistence
also: by sensor type (gas, fire, security first)
evaluation.success: model minus persistence event recall at 10 cards/day has a week-block 95% lower bound > 0 and card precision is not lower than persistence minus 0.02
evaluation.failure: otherwise the persistence rule is the demonstrated forecast and the model is reported as not better
evaluation.tz_targets: Precision 0.7 / Recall 0.5 are organizer defaults; values below are reported with justification (organizer Q&A)

inference_budget: TZ: scoring for one object <= 5 minutes; measure batch time per object
